item.title: Cybersecurity – The customer viewpoint
item.dc:creator: Jason Makar
item.description: In this episode, Nick Cappi, Hexagon Asset Lifecycle Intelligence division, discusses the importance of centralized asset inventory, its impact on safety, and the significance of visibility, alerting and reporting in industrial facilities.

item.title: Digitally transforming project execution
item.dc:creator: Jason Makar
item.description: In this podcast episode, hosted by Jay Schwartz, VP Strategy & Enablement at Hexagon's Asset Lifecycle Intelligence division, we discuss how digital transformation continues to change the way EPC companies execute complex projects. Jay is joined by Vijaykumar Mali, Digital Transformation Manager at Lamprell, and Lorne Jensen, Global Data Manager at Fluor.

item.title: Operational Technology (OT) cybersecurity – the vital next step in digitalisation (Part 3)
item.dc:creator: Jason Makar
item.description: In the third episode of our 'Operational Technology (OT) cybersecurity – the vital next step in digitalisation' podcast series, we discuss the importance of choosing the right strategic cybersecurity program for critical infrastructure.

item.dc:creator: Jason Makar

item.dc:creator: Travis Sachs
item.description: HxGN LIVE Global showcases unforgettable industry solutions and digital innovations in fabulous Las Vegas. Travis Sachs, an attendee of 2022’s conference, recounts his favorite parts of the experience below.

item.title: Asset Investment Planning: Delivering value across the asset lifecycle
item.dc:creator: Jason Makar
item.description: Today’s competitive market makes it more important than ever for asset-intensive organizations to adopt asset investment planning (AIP) to help determine how to best spend their limited capital to ensure their assets deliver the highest level of service across the asset lifecycle.

item.title: Beyond today
item.dc:creator: Jason Makar
item.description: Join Hexagon’s Safety, Infrastructure & Geospatial division president, Steven Cost, and guests as they explore how Hexagon's solutions can help you see, understand and address today’s challenges while also offering a clear path to a better tomorrow.

item.title: Delivering intelligence at scale
item.dc:creator: Jason Makar
item.description: As one of the secret ingredients behind some of Hexagon’s most recent innovations, Xalt is enabling Hexagon’s solutions to work seamlessly together to deliver intelligence at scale. In this episode, Johannes Maunz, Xalt’s Program Director, discusses Xalt’s creation, where they are today and what we can expect in the future.
